fields.name: Devourer
fields.rules_text_raw:
Arrival: Reveal each Hero's hand and
banish card from each Hero's hand.
While there are cards banished by this card, this creatures
health is equal to the combined cost of the banished cards.
When this card kills a creature, banish it instead. When this
card damages a Hero, banish a random card from its hand.
All cards banished by this are put in their owners
hands when this creature leaves play, even if it
no longer has this ability.
